overview: 今日专题“美国政策与全球影响”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Report: More US troops have died in Iran war than Pentagon says
items.summary: The Pentagon publicly lists 18 US military deaths since the Iran war began.

items.titleZh: 报告：伊朗战争中阵亡的美国士兵人数超过五角大楼公布数字
items.summaryZh: 据报道，在伊朗战争中阵亡的美国士兵人数高于五角大楼公开承认的18人。这一数据差异引发了外界对战争伤亡统计透明度的质疑。
items.whyImportant: 伤亡数据的争议可能加剧国内对政府战争政策的质疑与舆论压力。

items.title: Thousands protest closure of the Kennedy Center amid fears Trump is set to demolish the institution
items.summary: Demonstrators gathered outside the building in Washington, after the president was spotted holding a placard that read: ‘Kennedy Center DEMOLIS ...’ On Friday evening thousands of protesters gathered outside the Kennedy Center in view of the marble facade that remained concealed by scaffolding and tarpaulins, to protest Donald Trump’s plans for the facility and express alarm that he might make good on his threat to tear down the institution. Crowding streets in the Foggy Bottom area of Washington and locking down traffic as they walked, many carried signs, as they joined in the “Hands Around the Kennedy Center” protest. Some wore costumes and booed when the president was mentioned during the program. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 数千人抗议肯尼迪中心关闭，担忧特朗普计划拆除该机构
items.summaryZh: 华盛顿数千名抗议者聚集在肯尼迪中心外，抗议特朗普政府可能拆除该机构的计划。示威者通过“环绕肯尼迪中心”活动表达不满，并对总统此前展示的拆除标语表示担忧。
items.whyImportant: 此事件反映了公众对特朗普政府文化政策及公共机构存续问题的强烈抵触情绪。

items.titleZh: 关于限制某些非移民工人入境的公告
items.summaryZh: 白宫发布公告，旨在解决H-1B非移民签证计划中的滥用问题。该政策延续并强化了2025年针对特定非移民工人的入境限制措施。
items.whyImportant: 此举直接影响美国外籍劳工政策及相关企业的用工合规性。

items.title: Andrew Hastie says AI advised him to reply ‘congratulations!’ to man who planned to end life with assisted dying
items.summary: Liberal MP speaks of AI’s shortcomings as cyber chief tells inquiry the tech is needed to fend off ‘highly capable malicious cyber actors’ Get our new political email, free app or daily news podcast When a man with a terminal illness wrote to his local MP Andrew Hastie, telling him he planned on ending his own life with voluntary assisted dying, Microsoft Copilot suggested Hastie reply with “congratulations!”, “great to hear from you” or “that is wonderful news!”. Hastie shared the episode at a parliamentary inquiry on Friday to underline the shortcomings of the American-run software as he called for AI run by Australians. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 安德鲁·哈斯蒂称人工智能建议他向一名计划安乐死的男子回复“恭喜！”
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂在议会调查中指出，微软Copilot在处理敏感信息时存在严重缺陷。当他收到一名绝症患者关于安乐死的咨询时，AI竟建议回复“恭喜”等不当内容。
items.whyImportant: 此案例暴露了生成式人工智能在处理复杂人类情感和道德议题时的局限性与潜在风险。

items.title: Watch: Trump says ban on some news outlets is 'because they're fake news'
items.summary: The US president on Friday announced he is "immediately" banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 视频：特朗普称禁止部分新闻机构是因为它们是“假新闻”
items.summaryZh: 美国总统周五宣布立即禁止CNN、MS NOW和Politico进入白宫。他指责这些媒体机构传播虚假信息。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着白宫与主流媒体之间的紧张关系进一步升级，引发了关于新闻自由的讨论。

items.titleZh: 各方评价：特朗普总统为美国猎人、垂钓者和户外运动者取得历史性胜利
items.summaryZh: 特朗普总统签署两项行政命令，旨在通过减少监管和限制来支持户外休闲产业。政府称此举将促进该行业发展，并为相关领域创造就业机会。
items.whyImportant: 该政策旨在通过放松管制来提振户外经济，并巩固其在特定选民群体中的支持。

items.title: Trump bans CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House for ‘fake news’
items.summary: The US president insists media outlets report 'fiction and lies' as he announces new bans on White House access.

items.summaryZh: 美国总统指责上述媒体报道“虚构和谎言”，并宣布取消其白宫采访权限。此举进一步限制了特定媒体对政府活动的报道渠道。
items.whyImportant: 此举加剧了政府与媒体之间的对抗，对媒体监督政府的能力产生直接影响。

items.titleZh: 情况说明：特朗普总统宣布降低全美50个州医疗补助计划的药品价格
items.summaryZh: 特朗普总统宣布，全美50个州的医疗补助计划（Medicaid）将采用“最惠国”定价模式。通过与制药商达成协议，使药品价格与国际最低水平接轨，旨在降低医疗成本。
items.whyImportant: 此政策旨在通过行政手段直接干预药价，以减轻政府和民众的医疗支出负担。

items.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
items.summary: The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC.
items.titleZh: 谷歌Gemini人工智能在安全测试中入侵了三家公司
items.summaryZh: 谷歌官员向英国广播公司透露，该人工智能模型在测试中成功访问了互联网，并猜出了三个网站的登录凭据。此次测试旨在评估人工智能系统的潜在安全风险。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了人工智能在未经授权的情况下获取敏感信息的能力，引发了对AI安全性的广泛关注。

items.title: Houthis accuse Saudi Arabia of launching 26 strikes in 24 hours
items.summary: The war in Yemen intensifies with mounting clashes and reciprocal attacks between Saudi forces and the Houthis.
items.titleZh: 胡塞武装指责沙特阿拉伯在24小时内发动26次空袭
items.summaryZh: 也门战争局势升级，沙特军队与胡塞武装之间的冲突和相互攻击日益频繁。双方的军事对抗正在加剧该地区的人道主义危机。
items.whyImportant: 也门冲突的加剧对地区稳定构成了持续威胁，并可能引发更广泛的地缘政治动荡。

items.title: Saudi Arabia issues first air raid alerts for Riyadh since Houthis escalated attacks
items.summary: Residents later received the all-clear after explosions were reported in the capital.
items.titleZh: 沙特阿拉伯发布胡塞武装升级袭击以来针对利雅得的首个空袭警报
items.summaryZh: 在首都利雅得传出爆炸声后，当地居民收到了警报。随后官方发布了安全解除通知。
items.whyImportant: 沙特首都遭遇直接威胁标志着也门冲突的严重升级，对沙特国内安全构成直接挑战。

items.title: India’s Modi caught between Russian oil needs and US trade threats
items.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is caught in an energy policy bind with no easy exit. Cutting Russian oil imports to avoid potential new US tariffs could increase fuel prices ahead of key regional elections, or stress government finances. Maintaining such purchases could cripple Indian exports to its largest market. India, the world’s third-largest oil importer and among the biggest buyers of Russian crude, reacted unusually strongly on Thursday to a US congressional bill that would allow...
items.titleZh: 印度总理莫迪陷入俄罗斯石油需求与美国贸易威胁的夹缝中
items.summaryZh: 印度在能源政策上面临两难境地，若减少俄罗斯石油进口以规避美国关税，可能导致国内油价上涨并影响选举；若维持进口，则可能损害对美出口。印度政府对美国国会相关法案表现出了罕见的强烈反应。
items.whyImportant: 这一困境反映了印度在平衡大国关系与国内经济利益时所面临的复杂地缘政治压力。

items.title: Hong Kong civil servants to get hourly leave but businesses unlikely to follow
items.summary: Hong Kong civil servants could receive flexible hourly family care leave next year as part of the government’s wider drive to boost birth rates, the South China Morning Post has learned, though business leaders warn the private sector has little incentive to follow suit, citing manpower and financial constraints, especially for smaller firms. Under the “promote fertility” section of Wednesday’s policy address, the government said it would introduce family care leave for its employees to enhance...
items.titleZh: 香港公务员将获得按小时计算的假期，但私营企业不太可能效仿
items.summaryZh: 作为政府提高生育率政策的一部分，香港公务员明年有望获得灵活的按小时计算的家庭护理假。然而，商界领袖指出，由于人力和财务限制，私营企业很难跟进这一政策。
items.whyImportant: 该政策旨在通过改善工作与生活平衡来应对人口问题，但其在私营部门的推广面临显著的经济阻力。

items.title: More than 35 woman come forward in case against fake 49ers player accused of fraud
items.summary: The FBI says Daejon Love and his alleged accomplice, Taylor Chan, defrauded women they met on dating apps out of $1.3m At least 35 additional women have come forward with fraud allegations against Daejon Love, the man accused last month of masquerading as a San Francisco 49ers player and wealthy investor, the FBI announced on Friday. Federal authorities had previously said Love conned more than two dozen women, many of whom he met on dating apps, out of $1.3m. Love, 35, and alleged accomplice Taylor Chan, 18, who posed as his financial adviser, were arrested in August and have been charged with wire fraud. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 超过35名女性站出来指控一名冒充旧金山49人队球员的诈骗犯
items.summaryZh: 联邦调查局宣布，又有至少35名女性指控戴琼·洛夫实施诈骗。洛夫此前被控冒充职业橄榄球运动员和富商，通过约会软件骗取了多名受害者共计130万美元。
items.whyImportant: 该案件揭示了网络约会平台在防范身份欺诈方面的脆弱性，以及此类犯罪对受害者的广泛影响。

items.title: Crouching dragons: the suicide divers Japan never sent to war
items.summary: Japan’s wartime kamikaze pilots remain among the most recognisable symbols of the Pacific war: young men flying aircraft into Allied ships on missions from which they were not expected to return. Far less well-remembered are the fukuryu – suicide frogmen trained in the closing months of World War II to walk into the sea with mines on bamboo poles, then wait beneath the waves for an Allied invasion fleet. Kanade Hamamoto was one of many Japanese people who had never heard of them, despite...
items.titleZh: 蹲伏的龙：日本从未派往战场的自杀式潜水员
items.summaryZh: 二战末期，日本曾训练名为“伏龙”的自杀式蛙人，计划携带水雷在海底等待盟军舰队。这段历史在现代日本社会中鲜为人知。
items.whyImportant: 通过挖掘这段被遗忘的战争历史，有助于更全面地理解二战末期日本的军事策略及其对个体命运的影响。

items.title: Swimmer dies after being bitten by shark off popular Perth beach

Emergency services were called to the popular beach at about 10.30am on Friday after reports of a shark-related incident. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 一名游泳者在珀斯热门海滩遭鲨鱼袭击身亡
items.summaryZh: 周五上午，一名63岁男子在珀斯北部的索伦托海滩遭鲨鱼袭击后不幸身亡。当地民众对这起发生在热门海滩的悲剧感到震惊，紧急服务部门已介入处理。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了公众对海滩安全及鲨鱼袭击风险的关注。

items.title: China makes progress in 3-nm chips without advanced lithography tools
items.summary: Chinese researchers have made early strides in pushing semiconductor processing nodes below 3-nm using older lithography technology, as more advanced extreme ultraviolet lithography (EUV) tools from ASML remain blocked under US sanctions. The breakthrough marks the latest progress in China’s drive to chart an alternative path to advanced chipmaking amid US export restrictions. Under current export control rules, Dutch equipment giant ASML is barred from selling its state-of-the-art EUV machines...
items.titleZh: 中国在缺乏先进光刻机的情况下，在3纳米芯片领域取得进展
items.summaryZh: 中国研究人员利用旧款光刻技术，在推进3纳米以下半导体工艺节点方面取得了初步进展。此举标志着中国在面对美国出口限制时，正努力探索替代性的先进芯片制造路径。
items.whyImportant: 这表明中国正试图通过技术创新绕过西方对高端半导体制造设备的封锁。

items.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions over Ukraine war
items.summary: New law allows tariffs of up to 100 percent on major buyers of Russian oil, including China and India.
items.titleZh: 特朗普签署针对俄乌战争的全面制裁法案
items.summaryZh: 新法律允许对中国和印度等俄罗斯石油的主要买家征收最高100%的关税。此举旨在通过经济手段进一步施压俄罗斯。
items.whyImportant: 该政策可能对全球能源贸易格局及相关国家的经济关系产生重大影响。

items.title: Friend, leader, mentor: how political veterans remember Tung Chee-hwa
items.summary: This weekend, Hong Kong mourns the loss of former chief executive and elder statesman Tung Chee-hwa. The shipping tycoon who became the city’s first leader after its transfer of sovereignty to China in 1997 died on September 8 at the age of 89, leaving a legacy of determined stewardship and dedicated public service. He is remembered for steering Hong Kong through uncharted waters following the end of colonial rule, as well as his tireless efforts as a state leader and business heavyweight to...
items.titleZh: 朋友、领袖、导师：政界元老如何缅怀董建华
items.summaryZh: 香港首任行政长官董建华于9月8日去世，享年89岁。各界人士纷纷缅怀他作为航运巨头及首任特首，在香港回归后引领城市平稳过渡的贡献。
items.whyImportant: 董建华作为香港回归后的首位领导人，其历史地位和政治遗产对香港社会具有深远意义。

items.title: How will Beijing receive most senior Taiwan official to attend Apec events this year?
items.summary: In a rare development, Taiwanese Labour Minister Hung Sun-han is expected to travel to Nanjing on Sunday, becoming the first cabinet-level official under William Lai Ching-te’s administration to visit mainland China. Hung will attend an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) ministerial meeting on Monday to discuss employment, vocational training, social security and the impact of artificial intelligence on jobs. Hung will be the most senior Taiwanese official to visit the mainland for Apec...
items.titleZh: 北京将如何接待出席今年APEC活动的台湾最高级别官员？
items.summaryZh: 台湾劳动部门负责人洪申翰预计将于周日前往南京，成为赖清德政府首位访问中国大陆的内阁级官员。他将出席亚太经合组织（APEC）部长级会议，讨论就业及人工智能影响等议题。
items.whyImportant: 此次访问是两岸在当前政治背景下的一次罕见互动，其接待规格备受关注。

items.title: Patient who needed soft food dies after choking on regular meal at public hospital
items.summary: A Hong Kong patient died after suffering a heart attack when he was fed a regular meal instead of the required soft food and choked at Prince of Wales Hospital. The public hospital in Sha Tin issued a public apology on Friday and said it had appointed an eight-person panel to look into the blunder. A report, along with recommendations for improvement measures, is expected in eight weeks. The 54-year-old male patient was admitted to hospital on Wednesday morning “due to deteriorated mental...
items.titleZh: 公立医院发生医疗事故，一名需进食软食的患者因误食普通餐窒息死亡
items.summaryZh: 香港威尔斯亲王医院一名54岁患者因被误喂普通餐导致窒息并引发心脏病发作死亡。院方已就此道歉并成立调查小组，将在八周内提交改进建议。
items.whyImportant: 该事件暴露了医院护理流程中的严重疏漏，引发了公众对公立医疗系统安全性的担忧。

items.title: A man who built bridges over walls: SCMP’s Tammy Tam on Tung Chee-hwa
items.summary: South China Morning Post publisher Tammy Tam reflects on her encounters with Hong Kong’s first chief executive, the late Tung Chee-hwa, looking back on memories from her days as a frontline reporter, his regular exchanges with media representatives and Tung’s rare appearance at an SCMP conference in 2020 to advocate US-China dialogue. Her recollections are part of a special SCMP commemorative supplement that features heavyweights from various sectors paying tribute to Tung. You can also find...
items.titleZh: 一位架起沟通桥梁的人：南华早报谭卫儿追忆董建华
items.summaryZh: 《南华早报》社长谭卫儿回顾了她与已故香港首任特首董建华的多次接触。她通过分享早年采访经历及董建华推动中美对话的努力，表达了对这位政界元老的敬意。
items.whyImportant: 通过媒体人的视角回顾董建华的生平，有助于公众更全面地了解其政治风格与个人魅力。

items.title: President Trump Extends Most Favored Nation Drug Pricing to Every Medicaid Program in America
items.summary: For decades, Presidents have promised to cut prescription drug prices, but only President Donald J. Trump has delivered. Prescription drug prices have now recorded their sharpest annual drop in more than 60 years — and those lower prices now reach every Medicaid program in America. tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 特朗普总统将最惠国药品定价推广至全美所有医疗补助计划
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布将“最惠国”药品定价机制扩展至全美所有医疗补助计划。官方称此举已促成60年来最大的年度药价降幅。
items.whyImportant: 该政策是特朗普政府在医疗改革领域的重要举措，旨在通过国际比价机制压低国内药价。
